---
name: "故障报告 / Bug report"
about: "本地启动、搜索、交互或排版问题 / Startup, search, interaction, or layout problems"
title: "[Bug] "
---

## 环境 / Environment

操作系统、浏览器、Node 版本、提交号、开发或生产预览模式。 / Operating system, browser, Node version, commit, and development or production preview mode.

## 复现步骤 / Steps to reproduce

说明页面地址、执行命令与最少操作。 / Provide the page URL, command, and minimum actions.

## 预期与实际 / Expected and actual behavior

说明应发生什么、实际发生什么。 / Describe what should happen and what happens instead.

## 证据 / Evidence

可附截图和必要日志；移除凭据、个人路径与其他敏感数据。安全漏洞请使用 SECURITY.md 中的私密入口。 / Attach screenshots or relevant logs with credentials, personal paths, and sensitive data removed. Report vulnerabilities through the private channel in SECURITY.md.
